statement: A deterministic script scripts/checks/code-navigability-budget.js measures every row of the code-navigability-and-mistake-resistance budget from a checkout and prints the unmet count as its last stdout line (--metric, --rows <name,...>, --json), reading one detector module scripts/checks/code-navigability-detectors.js that owns the AST detection of each pattern; measured at the sealing head it reports the baselines recorded in the epic table, a test measures it against a fixture tree it owns so the witness does not move when the repository moves, and the script passes the changed-path guideline checkers (eslint, literals, ambient intrinsics) without any baseline change.

constraints.statement: A row whose sealing measurement differs from the epic's recorded baseline is either a detector defect or an epic correction, recorded together in the same attempt; it is never a silent renumbering of either side.
The detector module is the only place a pattern is recognised. The budget script, the guideline audit and any test import it; none carries a second regex or AST walk for the same pattern (R01, R05).
The script reads the tree and, for a pattern promoted to ESLint, runs eslint in report mode for that rule id only. It writes nothing and changes no file (R27).
The literal, ambient-intrinsic and lint checkers are satisfied by changing this script, never by a baseline entry, a raised count or a path exclusion (R23).
